ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

2. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 30
   C. 120
   D. 46

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)

   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 22
   C. 38
   D. 19

8. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 21
   D. 9

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

10. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 10

11. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81

   D. 90

13. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 1

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

15. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 32

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 1
   C. 20
   D. 9

17. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

18. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 1

19. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

21. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12.5
   C. 6
   D. 25

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

23. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 43
   C. 41
   D. 49

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

25. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)

26. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)

27. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)

   C. 1
   D. 1

28. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32

29. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   D. 23

30. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 72
   C. 1
   D. 17
